feeds.title: Two Minute Rule

feeds.title: The Thesis Whisperer » Getting things done

feeds.title: Nirvana
feeds.description: Nirvana is a cloud-based task manager that keeps you in sync. Our mission is to make Getting Things Done as delightful as possible. Find the latest from the Nirvana team nuggets of GTD wisdom - Medium.
